weightPrecision: float32 in the shards; the WebGL backend uploads them into half-float textures at runtime, so the deployed arithmetic is 16-bit either way

thresholds.note: margin and entropy fitted on 84 out-of-scope images; rejection rate 70.2% measured on 84 held-out images

rejection.marginSelection: selected among 88 tied (margin, entropy) pairs spanning margin 0.00 to 0.43; 0.40 taken from the band-aware refit, which holds 95.2% retention under the measured half-float band where 0.43 falls to 94.1%
rejection.halfFloatScaledNote: the scaled figures multiply the measured shift by 3.055x to reach the 0.042463 confidence shift reported in the training notebook; that shift was measured on a model whose expanded_conv_depthwise_bn variance had overflowed to inf. The converter folds BatchNorm into the preceding convolution, and the largest weight in the deployed graph is 117.53 against a half-float ceiling of 65504, so no overflow occurs on the phone. The scaled figures are therefore a loose upper bound, not a measurement.
